text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading home from work when I hear
what
sounds like an argument.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sirius,
I'd appreciate it if you could ease
up a
little.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Say what now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Time and time again, you have taken a
large
group of students under your wing
and occupied
the track, have you not?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We've received several complaints
regarding this matter. While I
understand that you have your reasons,
that is no justification to hinder the 
other students' training.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's say I give up guiding
them. How do
you plan on taking care of
them?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In that regard,
I believe there is room for

discussion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is true that the students who come to
you are
indeed falling behind on their
training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To address that, I'm considering hosting
a special intensive training program,
complete with a
dedicated training
ground and instructors.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. What a perfectly
by-the-numbers answer.
Typical.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tell me. What happens to the people
who miss
out on this special program?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the event that happens, we shall
furnish yet
another opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And what happens if they can't attend
that one
either?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We would create yet another.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, a lovely plan! It just goes on and
on!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Look here, O mighty Emperor. You
don't
understand a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Most, if not all, of us are born with some
sort of
issues we have to face.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sickness. Injuries. Poverty. Poor
conditions
growing up.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And those issues will rear their ugly
heads when you least expect it, whether
that be during a race
or training. We
have no say in the matter.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What I'm saying is that, unlike a model
student
like you, they don't have a
guaranteed "next
time."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That means we have to focus on the
present. But if you don't look at each of
them individually, you
can't see the
present.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... You mean to say that it is in our
best interests to employ a training
system that
addresses their individual
needs.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is a logic to your argument.
Unfortunately,
it is also not very
feasible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The result of bowing to every individual
need is that everyone ends up
neglected. Not to mention, we cannot
give special treatment to any one
portion of the student body.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To that end, I conclude that providing
equal
opportunities for everyone does
the greatest
good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The discussion has come to a standstill,
with both parties at clear odds. Just as
I'm worrying about
how to find an
outcome...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. There's no point in continuing this.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there. I know you've been
secretly
listening in. Well, which one of
us is right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy cannot function if we
lose sight of what's best for everyone. As
a trainer, I have to
agree with Symboli
Rudolf.
choice_data_list: Agree with Sirius's focus on the i...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you're also on the side of
privilege.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I hate when people talk down to me.
But...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It takes guts to look me in the eye and
shoot me
down. I can respect that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fine. I'll take you all down next time.
That other
stick-in-the-mud included.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps pleased at having had the
opportunity to speak her mind openly,
Sirius Symboli leaves
looking rather
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sigh. And this is why I loathe talking to the privileged.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice just observing things from
up on
high.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But don't forget, you never know what
people will
do when their backs are to
the wall.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Careful you don't find yourself on the
receiving
end of such indifference one
day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A uniform approach can't solve the
problems individuals face. I agree with
Sirius Symboli that we should respect
the point of view of each
student.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ah, so you can be reasoned with. Are you one of us, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, O mighty Emperor. You're not
omnipotent. You can't haggle with those
who don't fit your mold, and we'll never
understand each other. It's time you
come to terms with reality.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even should that be the truth, I wish to
continue my efforts in hopes that we can
come to a mutual
understanding some
day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, that means with you as well,
Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah. Is that so? If you really mean it, you could start by ditching that pompous, self-aggrandizing moniker of yours, Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their relationship is like oil and water,
but their shared ideal is probably closer
than they think. If they could both give
just a little bit, surely one day they
could get somewhere...
